bench press exercise induced greater myocellular and inflammatory damage compared with half squat.
bench press is a more stressful exercise compared with half-squat.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a bench press test is a better choice than a half-squat test when evaluating muscle strength in athletes.
a bench press incremental strength test is a more stressful exercise than a half-squat incremental strength test.

The main takeaway from our work is that
, when performing an incremental strength test with a similar workload, bench press exercise induces greater muscle damage than half-squat exercise.
, in order to avoid overuse injuries and promote recovery, it is recommended to include exercises targeting different muscle groups in the training regimen.
, at equivalent loads, the inflammatory and myocellular responses to a maximal incremental strength training are dependent on the muscles recruited.
